description.ja: 最強の戦士、超サイヤ人４孫悟空がパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
description.en: The strongest warrior, Super Saiyan 4 Son Goku, has been released with a renewed package! !

description.ja: • 大猿のパワーを宿した究極の肉体を、マッスルビルドシステムにより構築せよ！
description.en: • Build the ultimate body with the power of a great ape using the muscle build system!

description.ja: • 特徴的な赤い体毛や目の周りのふちどりもパーツ成形色で忠実に再現！
description.en: • The characteristic red body hair and edges around the eyes are also faithfully reproduced with parts molding colors!

description.ja: • 表情パーツは「通常」と「怒り」が付属！
description.en: • Normal and angry expression parts are included!

description.ja: • ひじ関節に引き出し構造を、腰パーツに左右に大きくスイングできる構造を採用し、驚異の可動域を実現！腰パーツの交換なしにフュージョンのポーズを実現。「Figure-rise Standard 超サイヤ人４ベジータ」（別売り）と組み合わせてフュージョンを決めよう！
description.en: • The elbow joint has a drawer structure, and the waist part has a structure that allows it to swing left and right, achieving an amazing range of motion! Achieve fusion poses without replacing waist parts. Create a fusion by combining it with "Figure-rise Standard Super Saiyan 4 Vegeta" (sold separately)!
